name: @iflow-mcp/github-copilot-engine-sdk
description: SDK for building engines on the GitHub Copilot agent platform

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle:mcp-server
scripts.bundle:mcp-server:
esbuild src/mcp-server-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/mcp-server.js && printf '#!/usr/bin/env node
' | cat - dist/mcp-server.js > dist/mcp-server.bundled.js && chmod +x dist/mcp-server.bundled.js
